description: This is a rectangular rug with intricate Persian patterns. The primary color is a rich red, with accents of dark blue, black, and hints of orange and cream. The design features a central medallion surrounded by smaller motifs, including stylized animals and floral elements. The borders are also elaborately decorated with repeating patterns. The rug has a fringed edge on one side, suggesting it's made of woven material. The overall impression is one of traditional craftsmanship and a vibrant, detailed aesthetic.
